subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: What Is Digital Accessibility
description: A quick win: understand What Is Digital Accessibility.

hook.text: A blind user visits a website. Every image says 'image.' Every button says 'button.' The site is useless.

buildup.text: Digital accessibility means people with disabilities can perceive, understand, navigate, and interact with content.

discovery.text: Disabilities include visual, auditory, motor, and cognitive impairments—each requiring different solutions.

twist.text: Over one billion people worldwide live with some form of disability. That's 15% of the global population.

climax.text: Accessible design benefits everyone: captions help in noisy rooms, large text helps in bright sunlight.

punchline.text: Accessibility isn't a feature for some. It's quality for everyone.

quiz.question: What percentage of the global population lives with a disability?
